title: 🎙️ Welcome to the FIRST Episode of Working Moms in Real Estate! 🎙️
description:
🎙️ Welcome to the FIRST Episode of Working Moms in Real Estate! 🎙️

Hi friends! We’re Gloria Watson and Marisa Barrett—two best friends, busy working moms, and passionate real estate professionals based in Central Texas. 💛 Join us as we launch this exciting new podcast where we keep it real, raw, and relatable!

From mom life chaos and beauty hacks to entrepreneurship and real estate tips, we’re here to share real conversations about balancing family, faith, careers, and building financial freedom. Whether you’re a fellow working mom, a real estate professional, or someone looking for inspiration and a little laughter, this podcast is for YOU!

👩‍👧‍👦 In This Episode:
Meet your hosts and hear our personal journeys—from married life, single mom life and career transitions to finding joy in chaos.

How we went from corporate life and hairstyling to thriving in real estate.
Why faith and leaning on God helps us through the hard seasons.
Real talk about parenting styles, beauty hacks for busy moms, and hilarious mom fails!

✨ What to Expect in Future Episodes:
Expert real estate advice (made simple!) 🏡
Guest speakers including lenders, photographers, business owners, and even an esthetician!
Beauty hacks and product reviews 💄
Honest conversations about mom life, career struggles, and wins
Our new segment: "The Topic" — tackling life’s real issues, from parenting to career growth!

💬 We’d love to hear from you! Have questions about real estate, motherhood, or career transitions? We’re here to help—especially with all your real estate needs. Don’t hesitate to reach out!
